q: Your fixed unlock order is Mine, Fishing, Farm, Grove, Volcano, then Celestial. Where do the 4 new islands (Lotus Marsh, Thunder Crag, Azure Beast Ravine, Tribulation Peak) go?
ctx: Celestial stays last (it holds the Heavenly Gate ending).
o: After Volcano, before Celestial: ...Volcano, Lotus Marsh, Thunder Crag, Beast Ravine, Tribulation Peak, Celestial
Mixed in by difficulty (e.g. Lotus Marsh after Fishing, Thunder Crag after Mine)
